wish: someone should make an app that makes QR codes to swap contact info
spec:
Turns your name, phone, email and company into a vCard QR code, drawn on the device as you type.
Fill in the fields once (they are remembered), tap Show to scan, and the other person points their phone camera at it to save you as a contact.
It does not scan codes, send anything anywhere, or keep a list of other people's contacts.
notes: QR encoder (byte mode, level M, versions 1-40) is inline; output round-trip checked against jsQR for 1-2000 byte payloads.
